meta.title: Check-up & Cleaning | The British Dental Hub
meta.description: A comprehensive, visual, evidence-based dental assessment in Cairo, built around digital diagnostics and a clear, personalised treatment plan.

hero.title: A Comprehensive, Visual, Evidence-Based Assessment
hero.subtitle: Every check-up goes beyond a quick look — it's a considered, digitally supported assessment of your whole mouth, explained clearly at every step.

digitalAssessment.title: Your Digital Dental Assessment
digitalAssessment.subtitle: A clear, five-stage process that helps you see and understand exactly what we see, before any treatment is discussed.

examination.title: Clinical Examination
examination.description: A comprehensive review of your teeth, gums, and overall oral health, forming the foundation of every visit.

imaging.title: Diagnostic Imaging
imaging.description: Dental X-rays are used as part of the diagnostic assessment where clinically appropriate, not as a routine step for every patient.

photography.title: Intraoral Photography
photography.description: An intraoral camera captures precise, detailed images of your teeth and gums for a clearer picture.

diagnosis.title: Diagnosis
diagnosis.description: Findings are reviewed and explained clearly, so you understand exactly what we're seeing.

treatmentPlan.title: Personalised Treatment Plan
treatmentPlan.description: Any recommendations — or the absence of them — are explained visually, using your own images and findings.

digitalAssessment.footnote: Not every visit requires the same diagnostic imaging — X-rays and other investigations are recommended individually, based on clinical need, not as a standard step for every patient.

digitalRecord.title: Your Personalised Digital Dental Record
digitalRecord.subtitle: From your first visit, everything is gathered into one clear, personal record — so your care stays informed and consistent over time.

items.plan: A personalised treatment and prevention plan

consultationCta.title: Ready for Your Assessment?
consultationCta.description: Every visit begins with a comprehensive, digitally supported assessment. We'll walk you through exactly what we find and what, if anything, we'd recommend next.
consultationCta.noPressure: No pressure. Just honest clinical advice.
consultationCta.contactNote: Our team will personally contact you to arrange your consultation at a convenient time.
